title: Rule book and source encoding
summary: ConvRulesEditor keeps each rule book's encoding (ASCII-7 to UTF-16 BOM), asks before a lossy save, and raises a refused source to UTF-8 with BOM on a yes
intro: Work with non-ASCII captions and names without the editor turning them into question marks.

questions.ask: My rule book has umlauts / Cyrillic -- will Save keep them?
Why does the Convert tab ask to raise a .pas to UTF-8 with BOM?
Why was my UTF-16 book saved with a BOM?
